outcome: Maternal admission to Intensive Care Unit (ICU)
Admission to special care nursery/neonatal intensive care unit (SCN/NICU)
cohort: The study included 1,188,872 singleton births to women in Victoria, Australia, between 1999 and 2016.
finding: Social disadvantage was associated with higher odds of adverse maternal outcomes (ICU admission, PPH) and neonatal outcomes (perinatal mortality, preterm birth, LBW, SCN/NICU admission).
mod_finding: Social disadvantage was associated with higher odds of caesarean section, but unlike other outcomes, this did not show a persistent social gradient across time.
